plan: A support mage who roots for a long time with her sphere and protects her allies from crowd control.
aSurveiller: Her Q (Dark Binding). A slow sphere that roots you for several seconds: stay behind your minions and sidestep when she casts it.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her sphere (Q) stops on the first one hit.
Her shield (E) blocks magic damage and crowd control: wait until it's used before engaging.
When she casts her R, move away from her: the chains stun you if you stay too close.
forces: Very long root with her Q.
Protects an ally from crowd control with her E.
Her R stuns several nearby enemies.
faiblesses: Her sphere is slow and easy to see coming.

sorts.Q: Sphere that roots the first enemy hit for a long time.
sorts.W: Ground zone that damages, stronger on low-health targets.
sorts.E: Shield that blocks magic damage and crowd control.
sorts.R: Chains nearby enemies: stunned if they stay in range.

momentFort: Annoying from the start with her Q, and more dangerous in team fights from level 6.
